data.name: No Hikers Return
data.detailed_description:
What happens when a search for a missing friend leads you to a place that was never meant to be found?

No Hikers Return is an immersive, first-person psychological horror game. You play as a desperate individual looking for your missing friend, which leads you to stumble upon a weird, isolated house hidden deep within a dark forest.

Explore the eerie surroundings and the unsettling interior of the house where the oppressive atmosphere, deep isolation, and constant tension will test your nerves until the very end.

Features:

  • Story-Driven: Search for your missing friend and uncover the dark secrets of a weird, abandoned house;

  • Genre: Atmospheric psychological horror;

  • Graphics: Realistic visuals and immersive environment design;

  • Exploration: Investigate a dense, creepy forest and detailed rooms;

  • Audio: Dynamic sound design—listen closely to your surroundings, because you are not alone here.

data.short_description: No Hikers Return is a psychological thriller-drama, not a standard jump-scare horror game. It is a descent into a secluded home where your missing friend may already be part of a much darker collection.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS 10, 11 (64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

content_descriptors.notes: No Hikers Return is a psychological horror game that features intense atmospheric tension, depictions of violence, and disturbing imagery. Players may encounter unsettling scenes, blood, and themes of psychological distress that are intended for a mature audience.
